The proposed aging temperature range (430–450°C) is a minor variation of the 580°C used in the literature, and the mechanism (Orowan bowing, coherent precipitates) is taken word for word from P11. The hypothesis does not combine findings from different papers, transfer the idea to a new alloy with justification, or propose a novel mechanism or test; it merely restates a known result as a prediction.
